title: linteljs choice folder share.json
description: Package versions live in the central versions catalog, never here. `pages` belongs to a shell's share.json only, `ui` to a shell's or one of its values'; `defaults` to a shell's or common/share.json.

defaults.description: Question key -> default value (a list for multi questions).

requires.description: Picking this folder's value requires another question to hold one of these values.

groups.description: Question folder only: group folder name -> the values it serves. A group folder is picked when the answer is any listed value; adding a value edits its list, never a path.

from.description: Import specifier of the provider module.

ui.description: Shell or shell value only: the ui layers it adds, in layering order.

layers.description: Shell or shell value only: the layer roots it takes (kit/react, app/react, shared), each walked by question and fact folders.

place.description: Shell only: logical root (ui, features, apis, i18n, styles, public) -> its directory; `pages` -> a page file template with {dir} (the page's directory from the shell's `pages` map), {page} and {Page}, the source extension kept; `naming` the file name casing; `tests` the test suffix.

platform.description: Shell or shell value, a fact: usable as a `platform/<value>/` folder in any layer.

localeStore.description: Shell or shell value, a fact: usable as a `localeStore/<value>/` folder in any layer.

pageKind.description: Shell or shell value, a fact: usable as a `pageKind/<value>/` folder in any layer.

framework.description: Shell or shell value, a fact: usable as a `framework/<value>/` folder in any layer.

pages.description: Shell only: page id, or `surface:<name>` for an extension surface -> its directory in the generated project, where shared per-page files (e2e specs) are placed.
